end.summary:
Recognised that festivals can vary by region and celebration style; some responses were right but this was not steady yet.
Practised linking harvest festivals with crops being ready; easy questions were right, with a why or new-situation question still to check.
Practised describing regional Diwali celebrations using diyas, rangoli, and food; a why or new-situation question is still to check.
The idea that harvest festivals relate to farming and seasons was still mixed up in the final response.
end.parentNote: Kavya practised comparing festival customs across regions, linking harvest festivals with crops being ready, and describing Diwali at home using diyas, rangoli, and gajar ka halwa. They gave several relevant examples, but the reason harvest festivals connect with farming and seasons was still mixed up at the end, so it was not corrected after the last time it appeared. At home, ask Kavya to explain why a harvest festival happens when crops are ready, then give a new example such as a crop ready in a different season.
